title: Make scripts/ a proper installable Python package
description:
The `scripts/` and `scripts/analysis/` directories are not proper Python packages — they have no `__init__.py` and aren't installable. This forces sys.path manipulation in orchestrator.py and pythonpath configuration in pyproject.toml for tests.

To fix:
1. Add `__init__.py` files to `scripts/` and `scripts/analysis/`
2. Add a pyproject.toml (or extend the existing one) to make scripts installable as a package
3. Remove sys.path hacks from orchestrator.py
4. Remove `pythonpath` from pytest config in puppeteer/pyproject.toml
5. Update all `from export_game import ...` to use the new package path
